asset.name: Vendor welcome
asset.description: Sent to the vendor contact when the vendor record is live.
asset.subject: Welcome aboard: {{legal_name}} is set up as a supplier
asset.html_body:
You are set up as a supplier

Hello,

{{legal_name}} is now an approved supplier. Your vendor number is {{vendor_number}}; please quote it and our PO number on every invoice.

Payments go to the bank account ending {{=RIGHT(iban, 4)}}. Any change to bank details must be confirmed by phone with our finance team.

Register on the supplier portal

Sent by the procurement team at your company
